title: Object
shortDescription: Uploading, copying, deleting, checking the existence of an object, and downloading its contents
metaDescription: All available methods for working with objects in VK Object Storage: download an object from a bucket (GetObject), upload an object to a bucket (PutObject), copy an object (CopyObject), get information about an object (HeadObject), delete an object (DeleteObject) or a group of objects (DeleteMultipleObjects)
